t: This Essentials freestanding shelving unit provides robust storage for workshops, garages, and utility rooms. Constructed from a durable powder-coated steel frame and strong MDF shelves, it offers reliable organisation for tools, paint tins, and bulky equipment. Each of the 5 adjustable shelves supports up to 100kg, making it ideal for heavy-duty items. With dimensions of 1800mm high, 900mm wide, and 400mm deep, this metal shelving unit maximises vertical space and can be used freestanding or wall-mounted for added stability. Its design ensures a tidy and efficient workspace.
